user = frappe.session.user user_data = frappe.get_cached_doc("User", user) billing_addresses = [] shipping_addresses = [] if user != "Guest": # Step 1: Find Customer via portal_users child table portal_user_link = frappe.get_all( "Portal User", filters={"user": user}, fields=["parent"] ) if portal_user_link: customer = portal_user_link[0]["parent"] user_logged_in = True user_data = frappe.get_cached_doc("User", user) # Step 2: Get all addresses linked to this customer address_links = frappe.get_all( "Dynamic Link", filters={ "parenttype": "Address", "link_doctype": "Customer", "link_name": customer }, fields=["parent"] ) address_names = [dl["parent"] for dl in address_links] if address_names: # Check if a Sales Order exists for this quotation so = frappe.get_all( "Sales Order", filters={"custom_quotation_reference": quot["name"]}, fields=["name", "transaction_date", "grand_total", "status", "net_total", "total_taxes_and_charges"], limit=1 ) if so: order = so[0] order["type"] = "Sales Order" orders.append(order) else: quot["type"] = "Quotation" quot["status"] = "Unpaid" if quot["status"] == "Open" else quot["status"] orders.append(quot) standalone_orders = frappe.get_all( "Sales Order", filters={ "customer": ["in", customer_names], "custom_quotation_reference": ["in", ["", None]] }, fields=[ "name", "transaction_date", "grand_total", "status", "net_total", "total_taxes_and_charges" ] ) for so in standalone_orders: so["type"] = "Sales Order" orders.append(so) #
